pages.text: $(l)Purpose$()$pManual four-wide greenhouse with configurable interior length and two central crop columns.$p$(l)Set up and operate$()$p1. Assemble Stable Stone ends, Flawless Glass walls and Bottom Quartz Slab roof.$p2. Put the CO₂ Generator at the correct near corner with matching facing.$p3. Use all fourteen seed inputs and supply FE.$p$(l)When it does not run$()$pIt has no automatic Build or Demolish controls. Wrong slab half, a missing end pillar or an over-limit length invalidates the layout.$pRead the active server settings below before copying default costs from another installation. For special slot roles, use the machine screen labels. Settings reporting does not inspect or mutate a placed machine.$pActual server settings: live server values are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$pCrafting / obtaining this machine: live recipe details are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$p$(l:foundations_calculator:multiblocks/flawless_greenhouse)Construction plans and layers$()
